brief_basis: User asks for a believable coherent garden bee home; one tree was an example, not a requirement.
courtyard:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment painting for a charming 2D bee game, landscape 16:10 composition, full scene at bee eye level, no UI, no text, no characters. This is a lived-in garden BEE HOME, not three separate props in a row, and not a requirement to use a tree.
Reference 1 is the approved game's leaf-canopy honey shop: retain its recognizable leafy curved canopy, two narrow shelves, tiny amber glass jars, cream ledger, but integrate it at modest scale into the LEFT entrance porch of the bee home. Reference 2 supplies only the golden muted mirror-ball design; remove its wooden arch and wooden disk platform entirely. Reference 3 supplies existing painted garden palette and sunlight, but replace its empty composition.
COMPOSITION in a 1280x800 design grid: one cozy rounded straw-and-wax bee house sits sheltered in a recessed opening of a low old garden stone wall, occupying x410..850 y250..650. An intact leafy shrub and climbing jasmine shelter the masonry from above, a few irregular roof tiles shed rain, the hive has a small dark entrance and visible protected comb details INSIDE, not exposed rows of giant honeycombs. Soft moss and small leaves at the masonry joins. The main home must feel weatherproof, inhabited and structurally grounded, all pieces appropriate to a bee-sized fictional society.
Left foreground at x390 y540 is the recognizable honey shop as a SMALL leafy serving counter attached to the main home, not an independent timber pavilion: front width230px, low counter at y590; shelves and jars connect naturally to porch. At x745 y515 an open cream botanical notebook rests on a sheltered flat stone ledge just beside the hive entrance: the book is a small readable visual landmark, no wooden lectern pavilion. On the right x1040 y460 hangs a lovely GOLD SAGE BLUE MIRRORED DISCO BALL, diameter75px, visibly suspended on one slender vine tied to the jasmine's intact living branch. Below it at x1040 y585 a broad living leaf grows from a grounded clump, creating an open bee dance landing with dappled light; no wood flooring, no arch. Give this corner air and a sense of occasion without neon or a generic fantasy portal.
A continuous open midground flight route connects the three locations, naturally stepped in depth and height, not symmetrical kiosks. Far right a gap between flowering plants suggests the flight out into the garden. Bottom edge has clover, moss, irregular smooth pebbles and a shallow water saucer with landing pebbles partly hidden by foliage. Small distant garden fence and pots establish larger human garden scale, softly out of focus, never competing with the hive. Leaves and flowers occupy more visual area than exposed wood. Main foliage framing at upper corners, warm honey and cream focal points, sage/emerald/lime greens, soft blue daylight through gaps.
Style: match reference painterly game art, warm organic dark contour lines, readable rounded shapes, hand-painted textured gradients, charming and inventive but rooted in a believable garden, coherent upper-left sunshine. Avoid photorealism, toy plastic, modern house facade, log cabins, three stumps, sawn logs, large wooden platforms, a giant chopped tree, disconnected stems, busy ornamental clutter, rows of identical flowers, UI, lettering, characters. A carefully composed complete environment, not a sprite sheet.
